name: Sprint
instructions: Warm up thoroughly with jogging and drills.
Accelerate from a stationary or rolling start.
Drive your knees and arms powerfully.
Run for 5 to 15 seconds at maximum effort.
longevityNotes: Cardiovascular fitness is the single strongest predictor of a long, active life. Regular cardio work keeps the heart, lungs, and brain in shape for decades.
overview: A maximal-effort short run that trains speed and power.

safetyNotes: Warm up fully; stop with any tightness in the hamstrings.
